body:
Its next private equity flagship is slated for early 2027, while parent company EQT is laying the groundwork for an infrastructure secondaries platform.

Following the establishment of a dedicated GP-led secondaries team earlier this year, the London-based firm has reportedly secured around €1 billion at first close.

Openstone Infraworld will initially target four funds managed by Macquarie, Partners Group, and Ares, including strategies focused on infrastructure secondaries.

The evergreen fund targets the energy, digital infrastructure, and transport sectors mainly through direct deals, complemented by secondaries and co-investments.

The second vintage of the secondary strategy has reached half of its €500 million target, and the programme has completed five investments across GP- and LP-led transactions.

The firm has appointed Loïc Beaumont as Head of Private Equity to lead the initiative that targets LP-led secondary positions in European buyout funds.

StepStone Secondaries Infrastructure Fund is approximately 50% deployed across LP-interest and GP-led transactions.

In July, the firm closed its debut program targeting the strategy with more than $5.5 billion in capital commitments.

The Euronext Amsterdam-listed manager is also preparing to launch two additional products focused on credit and infrastructure secondaries.
